bullets: description: Critical assessments of the literature and data sources pertaining to clinical topics, emphasizing factors such as cause, diagnosis, prognosis, therapy, or prevention. Systematic Reviews without meta-analysis are published as Reviews.
limits: body up to 3,000 words (not including abstract, tables, figures, acknowledgments, references, and online-only material)
limits: structured abstract up to 350 words
limits: Key Points up to 100 words
limits: 50–75 references
limits: up to 5 tables and figures combined
limits: title up to 100 characters including spaces
components: required sections: Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion, Conclusions
components: structured abstract under Importance; Objective; Evidence Review; Findings; Conclusions and Relevance
components: Key Points — Question (1 sentence), Findings (1–2 sentences), Meaning (1 sentence) — placed before the abstract
components: subtitle “A Systematic Review”
components: PRISMA (or MOOSE) followed; flow diagram in the online supplement
components: A table rates the quality of the studies and evidence
components: presubmission inquiry required before submitting

components: Acknowledgment section — author contributions; a data access statement by 1 or 2 named authors who had full access to all the data; conflict of interest disclosures for every author; funding and the funder's role; any AI tool used, with name, version, manufacturer and how it was used.
components: cover letter — complete contact information for the corresponding author and whether the authors have published, posted, or submitted any related papers from the same study
format: submit a Word document (not PDF); 10-, 11-, or 12-point font, double-spaced, right margins unjustified (ragged).
format: title page, abstract, text, references, figure legends and tables each start on a new page, numbered consecutively from the title page.

format: title page carries the title, every author's full name, highest academic degrees and affiliations, the corresponding author's complete contact information, and the manuscript word count (not including title, abstract, acknowledgment, references, tables, and figure legends).

format: AMA Manual of Style, 11th edition — references numbered in order of first citation, cited with superscript Arabic numerals; up to 6 authors listed, otherwise the first 3 and et al.; journal names abbreviated per PubMed.
format: tables at the end of the manuscript file, numbered in citation order, titles of 10–15 words, 10- or 12-point single-spaced, never as images.

format: each figure a separate file of at most 1 MB; photographs and illustrations at least 350 ppi, line drawings at least 600 ppi; no pie charts, 3-D graphs or stacked bar charts; avoid more than 4 panels.
format: individual files should stay under 500 kB and must not exceed 1 MB; the whole submission under 5 MB (video excluded).
extra: Key Points for reviews: 'Limit to no more than 100 words. This is different from the Abstract.'.
extra: The presubmission-inquiry email address is obfuscated in the page text and could not be recovered.
extra: Literature search as current as possible, ideally with end dates within a month or two before submission.
extra: Discuss current clinical practice guidelines in the Discussion.
